title: product-image upload reply
description: PROPOSAL product-images §4.1: 200 reply of PUT /api/v1/sync/product-images/{productId}. The same reply for a first picture (stored), a different picture (replaced) and a repeat of the picture already held (unchanged). New members may be added.

productId.description: The product id from the address, as the till sent it.

imageHash.description: SHA-256 of the bytes the till sent (X-SSPOS-Image-Sha256) for the picture the portal now holds. The till remembers it for the product.

result.description: stored: the portal had no picture for the product. replaced: it had another one (removed). unchanged: it already held this picture; nothing was written.

updatedAt.description: When the portal stored the picture it holds (UTC).
